== Islanders ==
[[File:LIUSA s8 cast.png|thumb|300px|{{center|'''The original islanders of the eighth season of ''Love Island USA''.'''}}<hr />'''Top:''' [[Beatriz Hatz|Beatriz]], Gabriel, [[Trinity Tatum|Trinity]], KC, Kenzie, Sincere and Aniya<hr />'''Bottom row:''' Zach, Melanie, Sean and [[Bryce Alakai|Bryce]]]]
The original islanders were announced on May 28, 2026.<ref name=":0" />

Islanders include Zach Georgiou, the brother of [[Love Island USA season 7|season 7]] islander Charlie Georgiou, Aniya Harvey, the daughter of retired NBA player [[Donnell Harvey]], Corey Sawyer Jr., the son of retired NFL player [[Corey Sawyer]] and cousin of [[Love Island USA season 6|season 6]] islander Daniela Ortiz-Rivera,<ref>{{Cite web |date=2026-06-23 |title=This Love Island USA Casa Amor Bombshell Is Related to Daniela From Season 6 |url=https://www.peacocktv.com/blog/corey-cousin-daniela-love-island-usa |access-date=2026-06-26 |website=Peacock |language=en-US}}</ref> and [[Beatriz Hatz]], a bronze medalist for Team USA's Paralympic track and field team.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Seitz |first=Loree |date=2026-05-28 |title='Love Island USA' Season 8 Cast: Meet the Islanders Headed to Fiji |url=https://www.thewrap.com/media-platforms/tv/love-island-usa-season-8-cast-islanders/ |access-date=2026-05-28 |website=TheWrap |language=en-US}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=2023-11-22 |title=Beatriz Hatz |url=https://www.teamusa.com/profiles/beatriz-hatz-1106919 |access-date=2026-06-18 |website=www.teamusa.com |language=en}}</ref>

Vasana Montgomery, a 25-year-old business owner from [[Beaverton, Oregon]] was originally announced as a contestant, however was removed from the series prior to entering the villa after several videos surfaced of her using racist language. As a result, Gabriel Vasconcelos entered on Day 2 as a bombshell due to an odd amount of islanders.<ref name="Vasana">{{Cite web |last=Weller |first=Sophie |date=2026-05-30 |title='Love Island USA' Contestant Removed From Villa Due To Resurfaced Video Using Racial Slur |url=https://parade.com/news/love-island-usa-contestant-removed-from-villa-due-to-resurfaced-video-using-racial-slur |access-date=2026-05-30 |website=TheWrap |language=en-US}}</ref> Alannah Keyser was removed from the villa on Day 19 due to a video surfacing of her using racist language, as well as screenshots of her using the same language.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Jacob |first=Arushi |date=2026-06-26 |title=‘Love Island USA’ Star Alannah Keyser Fired From Season 8, Second Contestant Booted for Using N-Word |url=https://variety.com/2026/tv/news/love-island-usa-casa-amor-alannah-keyser-n-word-1236787570/ |access-date=2026-06-26 |website=Variety |language=en-US}}</ref>
